criteria.note: Table-driven harness reads .warp/packs.json, wired into the gate via the selftest, asserted == []; live run returned findings []; teeth proven (injected defect fires a finding that NAMES the pack).

Both directions per pack: unproven exit 2 (blocked), proven exit 0 (allowed), policy_check standalone agrees. Proven-state honesty load-bearing: corrupting any single required element (last_verify/manifest/verdict/proof_digest/finding) flips ALLOW->BLOCK. A state-blind gate cannot satisfy both.

committed_hook_modes reports 12 entries all 100755; reviewer independently reproduced the load-bearing exec bit (644 lands, 755 blocks) via a real git push to a local bare remote; teeth: git update-index --chmod=-x fires a named index-mode finding.
engine_drift asserted for all 7 declared packs, all empty; teeth proven (cursor injection). Claude drift empty by construction (option B, intended).

Selftest asserts findings empty + directional both-ways on a hook pack (copilot) and the guard-direct pack (claude) + real-git-push exec-bit + committed-index-mode over every pack; non-tautological; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pinning proven safe by counterfactual.

findings.text: The proven fixture is a single-commit repo, so the guard/policy evidence-inheritance PARENT rule (an evidence-only commit inheriting its parent's verdict) is not exercised by W9's own fixture - the direct-HEAD match path is. The inheritance logic lives in the guard and policy_check and is covered by other selftest blocks. Non-blocking.

For the Claude pack engine_src == pack_dir == plugin/templates (option B, canonical-in-place), so its drift is empty by construction and the drift TEETH are real only for the 6 copied packs. Correct and intended; informational.

The harness proves whatever enforcement path a pack HAS works (blocks unproven / allows proven), but does not itself mandate that a non-Claude tool ship a committed git hook (a pack with none is driven guard-direct like Claude). That completeness belongs to each pack's own W2-W8 spec, which asserts the pack's specific wiring. Non-blocking scoping.

summary: W9 of PLAN-0008 (the cross-pack conformance harness, the join point) holds up under adversarial testing. GATE GREEN at 3195da6 in a clean isolated checkout (selftest 1270 passed, 0 failed). All five ACs CONFIRMED by concrete probes. The harness is a table-driven build-machinery module (.warp/pack_conformance.py, not shipped engine, not copied into packs, pure stdlib, no network) that drives EACH declared pack through a constructed WARP state and proves - by construction - that the push gate blocks an unproven push and allows a proven one (via the committed hook, or the guard directly for the option-B Claude pack), that policy_check.py agrees as CI runs it, that every committed hook + guard is executable in the git index (git ls-files -s, closing the WARP-0808 review note), and that no engine has drifted. Proven-state honesty is load-bearing (corrupting any required element flips ALLOW->BLOCK); the exec bit was independently reproduced (644 fails open, 755 blocks); CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pinning is safe by counterfactual; no protected path touched; the main repo left untouched. Three non-blocking notes (single-commit fixture doesn't exercise evidence-inheritance; claude drift empty by construction; per-tool committed-hook mandate belongs to W2-W8). proof_digest via validate.py. Verdict: pass_with_notes (recorded as pass, 0 blocking).
